verdict.rationale: Fivetran lets customers pick their cloud provider (GCP, AWS, Azure) and offers a Hybrid Deployment model where the processing agent runs inside the customer's own environment, which offers some control over where data resides — but there is no explicit documentation of selectable geographic regions or formal data-residency/compliance guarantees. Missing for 10: explicit region-selection UI/docs, formal data-residency certifications, and confirmation that data-at-rest location can be pinned to a specific geography.
